mapper.sql: a.article_id, a.title, a.author, a.published_time, a.content, a.collection, a.share, a.comment, a.star, a.stick, a.page_view
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname AS author_nick, u.portrait AS author_img, t.tag_id, t.tag_name FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id LEFT JOIN article_to_tag att ON a.article_id = att.article_id LEFT JOIN a_tag t ON att.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId} LIMIT 1

SELECT , u.nickname AS author_nick, u.portrait AS author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id WHERE a.author = #{userId} ORDER BY a.published_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_article WHERE author = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_article (title, author, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname AS author_nick, u.portrait AS author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id ORDER BY a.page_view DESC LIMIT #{limit}
